notes: EHNOTE provides no data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation. The export consists of PDF case sheets and image files. The only field-level information is a single sentence listing broad categories: 'Name of the clinic, patient demographics, Chief complaints, Review of systems, Assessments, Medications and other clinical data part of the appointment.'

export_file_types.description: Case sheets - one PDF per appointment per patient containing clinical history
export_file_types.content_described_as: Name of the clinic, patient demographics, Chief complaints, Review of systems, Assessments, Medications and other clinical data part of the appointment

export_file_types.description: Image files for investigations, surgery consents, referrals, billings and authorization documents
